primarySourceFinding.assets: Linux x64 dual CUDA12.9/13.4 split into four parts; single CUDA12.9 SM70/75/80/86/89 split into three parts. Official release lists SHA-256 for every part.

localEvidence.Q181: Q181/results documents three interleaved passes on a separate public local fixture; it was not the Harness² integration/holdout asked for in source #13.
localEvidence.Q183: Q183 explicitly distinguishes Q181 from a real Harness² execution and keeps this item pending on exact integration and isolation requirements.
localEvidence.modelAssets: Q179 already qualified the NInfer-all source commit and dual-GPU SOL artifact; no model test is warranted solely to restore a runtime binary.
localEvidence.processes: No inference server was present. nvidia-smi listed desktop graphics processes only.

decision: No download, build, server, inference, benchmark, or GPU use. The runtime binary is retrievable, but that does not define Harness² integration, endpoint, or a distinct holdout. The earlier VF source #15 review says another holdout would duplicate evidence absent a new local decision.
nextCondition: Identify a specific Harness² workflow/commit and a decision that is not covered by Q181/Q172 before preregistering new model work.
